agents.trustWarning: New agents start at Trusted. Once you create one, it does its work without asking you each time, even for things like posting outside, using the web or installing tools. It still asks before dangerous actions (reading a secret, deleting data, using your computer), and a message that reaches it through Telegram or another chat app never gets more than Standard. To be asked more often, choose Standard or Guarded for that agent, or change the level new agents start at in Settings.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Switches every screen of this app.
settings.newAgentsHint: The trust level a new agent starts at. You can still change it for each agent.
settings.alwaysAsksIntro: Even a trusted agent asks you first, every time, before it does these. There is no "always allow" for them, and a chat channel or an automation cannot approve them.
settings.alwaysAsksMoney: Money: buying, paying, checking out, placing an order, subscribing, using payment details, sending money or crypto.
settings.alwaysAsksMessage: Messages to other people: an email, chat, DM or post to anyone other than your own linked chats. An agent replying to you in your own chat does not ask.
settings.alwaysAsksDelete: Deleting outside the agent's own workspace: files or folders of another agent or anywhere else on this computer, another agent's or a shared data table, and anything an outside tool or connector marks as destructive. Deleting inside the agent's own workspace does not ask.
settings.alwaysAsksAdd: You can also make these always ask:
settings.alwaysAsksLimit: An agent you give a terminal can do anything a terminal can; the always-ask cards cover tools PasaBot can see. A shell command or a raw web request can send a message or pay without a card. To be asked first, turn on "Ask before terminal and raw web commands" for that agent.
settings.intro: Everything that isn't a chat lives here. Pin what you use every day to the sidebar.
settings.hideBody: It disappears from Settings and the sidebar for everyone. Nothing is deleted. Turn it back on in Settings › Advanced.
settings.hiddenNote: You hid this feature. It still works; it is only left out of lists.
settings.notUsingEmpty: You're using everything. Hide a feature from its page when you don't need it.
settings.groupEmpty: Nothing here right now. Hidden features are in Advanced.
settings.searchEmpty: Nothing matches "{{q}}". Try a simpler word.
settings.resetSidebarHint: Takes every pin off the sidebar. Nothing else changes.
settings.tidied: We tidied up. Everything is in Settings now — pin what you use to the sidebar.
settings.advancedHint: Shows names like "Trust level" and "MCP server", and the pages for technical setup.
settings.technicalOnly: For technical setup — turn on {{switch}} to see these
settings.technicalOnlyPage: This page is for technical setup — turn on {{switch}} to see it.

agents.trustWarning: New helpers start at “Asks only before dangerous things”. Once you make one, it does its work without asking you each time, even for things like posting outside, using the web or installing tools. It still asks before dangerous things (reading a secret, deleting data, using your computer), and a message that reaches it through Telegram or another chat app never gets more than “Asks before risky things”. windows-no-sandbox.title: Helpers on this Windows PC have no safety box
windows-no-sandbox.text: On Windows, PasaBot cannot keep helpers inside their own folder yet, so a helper could open any file you can. That is why new helpers ask you before they do anything outside their folder. Only add helpers you trust.

linux-sandbox-missing.title: Helpers cannot start yet
linux-sandbox-missing.text: This computer is missing a small safety tool called bubblewrap. Ask whoever looks after this computer to install it, then start PasaBot again.

linux-sandbox-userns.title: Helpers cannot start yet
linux-sandbox-userns.text: This Linux blocks the safety box that helpers run in. Whoever looks after this computer can allow it with one setting, then start PasaBot again.

linux-sandbox-other.title: Helpers cannot start yet
linux-sandbox-other.text: The safety box that helpers run in would not start on this computer. Ask whoever looks after this computer to check it.

vault-unavailable.title: Saved keys and passwords are locked
vault-unavailable.text: PasaBot could not open its safe this time, so it cannot save or use keys and passwords. Start PasaBot again. If it keeps happening, run the check on this page.

vault-key-file.title: Your safe’s key is kept in a file
vault-key-file.text: This computer has no keyring, so PasaBot keeps the key to its safe in a file only your account can open. Programs you run yourself could still read it.

data-folder-open.title: PasaBot’s folder may be open to others
data-folder-open.text: Windows did not let PasaBot lock its folder to your account, so other accounts on this PC might see your chats and keys. Run the check on this page to see more.

signin-links.title: Codex and OpenCode need one Windows setting
signin-links.text: To let helpers use your Codex or OpenCode sign-in, turn on Developer Mode in Windows Settings, then start PasaBot again. Claude works without it.

check.title: Check this computer
check.text: Runs a short check that PasaBot works on this PC and shows what passed. It uses a test folder, never your own data.
check.notInstalled: The check comes with the installed Windows app. Install PasaBot to use it.
check.started: The check opened in its own window.
check.failed: The check did not start. Please try again.
